answer: Reaching the juniper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The opal is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
